data.title: Flat Design
data.tagline: Use simple shapes, clear color, and minimal surface decoration
data.description: Flat design removes realistic texture and depth in favor of icons, type, color blocks, and direct layout. It scales well and keeps visual noise low, but interactive elements still need recognizable shapes, contrast, and states. Pure flatness that hides what is clickable is not useful simplicity.

use: A design system that needs broad reuse
avoid: Use color alone to show interaction
Add flat icons that users cannot recognize

data.agentPrompt: Flat design system, solid color blocks, simple geometric icons, minimal shadows, strong typography, generous whitespace, clear control boundaries and accessible interaction states

references.title: Flat Design: Its Origins, Its Problems, and Why Flat 2.0 Is Better for Users
